metadata.warning: Baseline reclassification model: administrative race/color (DATASUS SIM/SINASC/SIH, recorded by the notifier over the same 5 IBGE categories) is taken as equal to IBGE self-declared census race. This is the standard baseline used by Brazilian vital-statistics race analyses that lack record linkage. It makes NO reclassification correction; documented admin-vs-self-declared discordance (chiefly the branca/parda/preta boundary) is NOT modeled. Replace with a linkage-calibrated emission matrix (record-linked SIM<->census, or a validation-survey confusion matrix) for reclassification-corrected estimates. Missing/invalid admin race is reallocated to the local self-declared composition (local-pi).
metadata.provenance: Identity emission matrix P(admin=k | self-declared=k)=1; codes map 1->branca, 2->preta, 3->amarela, 4->parda, 5->indigena (IBGE cor/raca coding).
